    "source": "generative",

    "source": "generative (gematria)",

    "languages": ["en", "fr", "la", "pi"],

  },

    "reading": "Water-house-eye-enclosure — the seeing vessel of the deep.",
    "languages": ["he", "en"],
    "source": "generative",
    "confidence": 0.4
  }
